decisions.reason: Multiline entry is an independent behavior already established by a separate clause in the same message; expanding placeholder-clearing scope does not change its state.

Persistent help labels can coexist with placeholder text clearing, and the candidate already covers all interactive fields; the source decision does not necessarily change any label attribute or scope.
The selected editable-field mechanism remains valid unchanged; extending placeholder-clearing behavior to additional templates does not alter that mechanism.
Fixed margins and clipping prevention are independent layout requirements introduced by another clause in the message, not consequences of the placeholder-clearing scope change.
The Master-template color policy is independent of placeholder activation behavior and remains unchanged.
Bullet size and spacing feedback is an independent observation in the source message and is not affected by the placeholder-clearing scope expansion.
Hard-return spacing and Shift+Enter behavior are governed by a separate clause and do not change because placeholder clearing applies in additional contexts.
The unintended border created after a Board Meeting Topic is a separate row-extension behavior unrelated to placeholder clearing.
The placeholder-clearing scope change does not modify the required legacy copy-paste workflow or resolve its existing ambiguity.
Complete style-set coverage remains unchanged; placeholder activation behavior does not add, remove, or redefine a required style.
Table and column stability during paste is independent of placeholder clearing, and the source decision does not resolve or alter the candidate's existing ambiguity.
Tab-controlled list hierarchy is unrelated to placeholder activation behavior, and its existing workflow ambiguity remains unchanged.
